newsitem.title: CANADA: Quebecor Inc to make issuer bid.
newsitem.headline: Quebecor Inc to make issuer bid.

text.p: Quebecor Inc said on Tuesday that its board approved the repurchase on the open market of up to 500,000 or 1.75 percent of its class A multiple voting shares and up to 500,000 or 1.34 percent of its class B subordinated voting shares.
The repurchases would be at prevailing market prices on the Toronto and Montreal Stock Exchanges between November 1, 1996, and October 31, 1997, Quebecor said.
It added that the aggregate purchase price would not exceed C$25 million, excluding brokerage fees.
The normal course issuer bid is in line with Quebecor's global investment policy.

"The company believes that during the next twelve months, the purchase of Quebecor's shares could be considered a good investment of the company's excess funds for its shareholders," the company said.
In the past 12 months, the company repurchased 45,700 class A shares and 150,000 class B shares at an average price of C$21.504 a share.
